title.zh: v2.0.73 页面双指滚动失效的根因（根样式 overscroll-behavior），以及让同一鼓件的连续敲击不再完全相同
title.en: v2.0.73 The Root Cause of Dead Trackpad Scrolling (overscroll-behavior on the Root), and Per-Hit Variation So Repeated Drum Strokes Stop Being Identical

highlights.zh: **页面在 macOS Chrome 上无法双指滚动，根因是根样式的 `overscroll-behavior: none`**（用户本人在真机二分确认）。这个属性的字面定义只是「禁止滚动链与回弹」，但 **Chrome 在支持触摸的桌面硬件上同样采纳它**，于是纵向的那一半把最基础的页面手势一并关掉了；Safari 宽松，所以同一份代码在 Safari 上正常。用户实测的四条对照解释了它为什么难查：`touch-action: auto` 正常、`overflow: auto` 正常、**程序化滚动正常**（`scrollY` 能改）、但**双指手势被静默忽略**。
highlights.en: **Two-finger trackpad scrolling was dead on macOS Chrome, and the cause was `overscroll-behavior: none` on the root** (bisected by hand on the affected machine). The property's definition is only "no scroll chaining, no affordance", but **Chrome honours it on touch-capable desktop hardware**, so the vertical half of the shorthand took the page's most basic gesture with it; Safari is laxer, which is why the same code was fine there. The user's four-way comparison explains why…

highlights.zh: **修法按轴拆开，且保留横向是刻意的**：`overscroll-behavior-x: none; overscroll-behavior-y: auto`。横向仍要挡——步进格子本身有横向平移，放开双指横滑会不断触发浏览器的历史导航（后退/前进）。值得一提的是 `src/index.css` 里**早就有正确写法的同类规则**（`.overscroll-x-contain`，步进面板在用），也就是说这个教训此前只在**局部**应用过，**根部**没跟上。代价已写进文档：纵向还给浏览器后，触摸设备上向下拖可能重新触发下拉刷新，这一轮取桌面可用。
highlights.en: **The fix splits by axis, and keeping the horizontal half is deliberate**: `overscroll-behavior-x: none; overscroll-behavior-y: auto`. Horizontal still needs suppressing — the step grid pans horizontally, so allowing the two-finger horizontal swipe would fire the browser's history navigation (Back/Forward) constantly. Worth noting: `src/index.css` **already contained the correct form of this rule** (`.overscroll-x-contain`, used by the sequencer pane), so the lesson had been…

highlights.zh: **我的诊断脚本给出的结论是错的，错法可复现**：它当时报「5 个变体都能滚动」，我据此说过「可能不是主因」。原因是它的每条探针都用 `window.scrollTo` **程序化**滚动或判断 `scrollHeight > clientHeight`——而 `overscroll-behavior` 管的是**手势与回弹**，不是滚动范围也不是滚动 API，所以它能诚实地报「都能滚」而真机纹丝不动。**教训：绕过输入路径的探针测不出输入路径的 bug。** 该脚本这一版加了一条读**计算样式**的结论行（`overscroll-x/y` 与 `touch-action`），不需手势与硬件，命中已知坏配置直接 `exit 1`。
highlights.en: **My own diagnostic reached the wrong conclusion, and the way it was wrong is reproducible**: it reported "all five variants scroll", and I told the user this might not be the main cause. Every probe in it scrolled **programmatically** (`window.scrollTo`) or asked whether `scrollHeight > clientHeight` — but `overscroll-behavior` gates the *gesture* and the affordance, not the scroll range or the scroll API, so it could honestly report "everything scrolls" while the real mach…
